pain_point: Need warehouse with office combo - I need warehouse space with a proper office attached — hard to find that as a package
primary_text: "I need warehouse space with a proper office attached — hard to find that as a package." We know. Most industrial listings are shed-only or the office is a glorified shipping container. These new Truganina warehouses are designed with integrated office space as standard — not an afterthought. Proper walls, climate control, data cabling provisions, and separate access. Your team works upstairs or alongside the warehouse floor without compromising on either function. Off-the-plan means you can influence the fit-out before it's built. Near the Princes Freeway with high-clearance warehouse space below. One property, one lease, one mortgage. Done.
description: Integrated office and warehouse under one roof as standard inclusions
